entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene. Sequester: one sleeping adult figure curled peacefully, nearly invisible translucent outline fading into clean space, suspended within a still oval veil; four tiny gemstone dust piles below. No coffin or prison, no visible solid armor, quiet suspended time.

review.notes: Local IAB32/40px, grayscale circle, Polaris/Coal/Atlas. Six spell motifs checked against 2014 catalog descriptions.
